name: Try to OOF 3 🧩 [+25 LEVELS]
desc:
🧩 Welcome to Try to OOF 3!

🚩 Complete various fun and creative puzzles by oof-ing!
⏳ Speedrun the game and compete with yourself and your friends to get the best time!

This game is available on all devices except for VR!
If you experience any bugs, please let me know in the community server or on the group wall so I can be sure to fix them!
🛠️ Join the group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/14391993

✨ This game was heavily inspired by Try To Die and Try To Die Dco!
